pages.description: PLUFSIG folding gym mat, pink/red, 78x185 cm Little acrobats can practice somersaults, vaults and jumping as much as they like on this soft foldable gym mat. That they also develop motor skills and coordination is something only us adults know. Folds flat; space-saving when not in use.
pages.ld_description: PLUFSIG Folding gym mat - pink/red 78x185 cm. Let your little one play and practise walking on this mat, the padding will make the landing from any falls a little softer. Folds flat; space-saving when not in use. Only recommended for indoor use. Recommended for ages from 18 months.
